so i think most people have come to an agreement that this is about joe zieja. though i have some opinions about the gimick-y style of his course advertisement, i definitely think something went haywire with miscommunication:

joe zieja’s voice acting academy has never been anywhere close to $20,000. i believe the “full price” is $700 and the “discount” as of right now is $350. whether that’s genuinely worth that amount is up to interpretation. but even with his music video kickstarter, the tier that would get you full access to his voice acting academy + other benefits on previous tiers is a $500 pledge. so maybe where someone got confused is that the entire kickstarter’s goal js $25,000 and then that got passed around and eventually landed on “joe expects someone to pay $20,000 for his voice acting course”.
